key_findings: mNAcSh D2 neurons are hyperactive after nerve injury; separate LHA-projecting (AM glutamatergic input, pain) and VP-projecting (LS GABAergic input, depression) pathways mediate distinct symptoms.
mNAcSh D2 terminals inhibit VP SST+ neurons, disinhibiting VP glutamatergic neurons to drive depression-like behavior.
